_doc: OpenKal dialogue text describing project-owned behavior; no external dialogue text is redistributed.
caption: Trigram enchantment
lines: In the inventory, drag a raw trigram onto an unequipped trigram of the same grade and position.
A successful attempt converts a raw target into an enchanted trigram at +1, or increases its enchantment up to +15.
An accepted attempt consumes the material even on failure. Failure lowers the target enchantment by one, to a minimum of zero.
This upgrade is performed in the inventory; no separate blacksmith enchantment window is needed.
